purpose: A original BCE; B adds multi-axis soft error disparity; C adds original-real/auxiliary sensitivity and matched processing-control stability; D adds conditional quantile response alignment.
scope: New procedural intervention method, not completion or relabeling of earlier demographic-edit or quartet experiments.
qualification: Required named stratified operator review before C/D; no approvals supplied
test_policy: No automatic TEST. Exact manifest/checkpoint/source binding and fit:test overlap exception required for later explicit evaluation.
baseline_policy: A-D share architecture, original order/weights, encoder checkpoint, fresh prediction-head seed, epoch budget, BN policy, selection and calibration. C/D have identical procedural views and source exposure. A/B vs C/D have different forward cost.
selection: earliest highest validation AUC; conservative validation-real FPR0.1 threshold
execution: GPU operator launches after allocation, fresh CUDA smoke, real input checks, dry runs and operator qualification; source immutable
remaining: fresh CUDA smoke and real backward on H100
Ding baselines and later evaluation plan; not provided as reproduced results
new-variant scientific validation and repeated-seed confirmation
primary_ablation: D minus C; same views and all objectives except response alignment
primary_fairness_endpoint: gender_race F_FPR at the checkpoint validation-real FPR0.1 threshold
validation_progression: D lower F_FPR than C, at most 0.005 absolute AUC loss, no worst-group AUC collapse; not checkpoint selection or TEST tuning
source_commit: The immutable Git commit containing this proposal; exact SHA in external handoff and cluster source_commit.txt
